changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A workspace has an authorization generation, which only a narrowing of its authority raises (KR-10, ADR 0134). Every workspace starts at generation 0. The trigger that raises it on every narrowing of a membership is installed with the column, so no narrowing can commit while the generation exists without it: a membership that ends, is left, moves or loses a role, whoever writes it.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Every run carries the generations it was requested under, and keeps them. A run that a boundary refuses ends AUTHORITY_CHANGED. Existing runs were requested at generation 0. The column keeps the default of generation 0 for a writer of the previous release: such a run is refused once any narrowing happened, never allowed. The checks are added without validation, so their row scan runs outside the exclusive schema lock.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validate the run checks while ordinary row writes can continue.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_stop_reason; ALTER TABLE agent_run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_authorization_stamp;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A review that a boundary stopped because its workspace's access narrowed records AUTHORITY_CHANGED.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason; ALTER TABLE review ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason CHECK(stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('TIMED_OUT','EXECUTION_FAILED','PREPARATION_FAILED','PROCESSING_FAILED','PERSON_DATA_ERASED','STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION','CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN','REPLACED','LEGACY_FAILURE','EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE','RESULT_WITHHELD','READINESS_REFUSED','SUSPECT_LISTING','BUDGET','USAGE_UNVERIFIABLE','DEADLINE','CANCELLED','ENUMERATION_FAILED','ENUMERATION_LIMIT','NO_SCAN_PRACTICES','MODEL_CHANGED','MODEL_UNAVAILABLE','ERROR','LEGACY_SCOPE_UNKNOWN','CONTRACT_CHANGED','NO_SANDBOX_ROOM','COMPOSITION_UNCONFIRMED','PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE','EVIDENCE_TOO_LARGE','SOURCES_MOVED','NOT_RUN','AUTHORITY_CHANGED')) NOT VALID;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE review DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason; ALTER TABLE review ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason CHECK(stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('TIMED_OUT','EXECUTION_FAILED','PREPARATION_FAILED','PROCESSING_FAILED','PERSON_DATA_ERASED','STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION','CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN','REPLACED','LEGACY_FAILURE','EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE','RESULT_WITHHELD','READINESS_REFUSED','SUSPECT_LISTING','BUDGET','USAGE_UNVERIFIABLE','DEADLINE','CANCELLED','ENUMERATION_FAILED','ENUMERATION_LIMIT','NO_SCAN_PRACTICES','MODEL_CHANGED','MODEL_UNAVAILABLE','ERROR','LEGACY_SCOPE_UNKNOWN','CONTRACT_CHANGED','NO_SANDBOX_ROOM','COMPOSITION_UNCONFIRMED','PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE','EVIDENCE_TOO_LARGE','SOURCES_MOVED','NOT_RUN'));

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validate the review stop reason check while ordinary row writes can continue. A rollback starts here, so it refuses before it changes anything while a run or a review records that its access changed.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason;
